srs: The court prosecution system records Case, Court, ProsecutionService, and Hearing; each has an id attribute. Each Case can have zero or more Court records, and each Court belongs to exactly one Case. Each Court uses exactly one ProsecutionService, and each ProsecutionService serves zero or more Court records. Each ProsecutionService manages one or more Hearing records by composition, and each Hearing belongs to exactly one ProsecutionService. Each Case can reference zero or more Hearing records, and each Hearing can be referenced by zero or more Case records.
